crossRefs.note: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.
The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders…
the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the…
the waters which came down from above stood, and rose up in one heap a great way off, at Adam, the city that is beside…
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

translations.web: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
translations.bsb: The latter five came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea ).
translations.kjv: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
translations.asv: All these joined together in the vale of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).
